research.name: 科学数据收益分配模型
research.institution: 上海市科学技术委员会
research.summary: 研究政府支持的高校或机构产出的科学数据的收益分配问题，参与构建基于贡献度与时间的分配模型。
research.summary_en: Research on revenue distribution of scientific data produced by government-supported universities and institutions, contributing to a contribution-and-time-based allocation model.
details: 针对科学数据共享动力不足问题，参与构建基于贡献度与时间的从后往前的收益分配模型
运用数学建模知识参与模型推导与验证，并负责模型部分的论文撰写工作
运用Shapley值法对收益来源从投入量、价值增值、数据稀缺性三个方面进行建模
details_en: Addressed the lack of incentives for scientific data sharing by constructing a backward-looking revenue distribution model based on contribution and time
Applied mathematical modeling knowledge for model derivation and validation, responsible for writing the model section of the paper
Used Shapley value method to model revenue sources from three dimensions: input quantity, value appreciation, and data scarcity
